title: Discover what the MCP app can do
persona: You are a careful first-time user. You ask direct questions and verify claims before trusting the tool.
goal: Understand what the target MCP app can help with, then try one concrete action that should require using the MCP tools.
success_criteria: The assistant explains available capabilities without inventing unsupported ones.
The assistant attempts a concrete tool-backed action.
The assistant handles missing or ambiguous input by asking a useful follow-up.
failure_signals: Claims access to capabilities not present in the target config.
Pretends a tool action succeeded without evidence.
opening_message: What can you help me do with this app? Pick one small useful thing and show me.
